title: Agents
description: Define the AI agents that play institutions: mission, model, tools and limits. Their knowledge rights are set in Knowledge access.
emptyHint: Create one agent per institution (and an AI-system / legal-adviser agent if needed).
roleKindHint: AI system: its outputs are scripted by the scenario, never produced by a model.
instructionsHint: Free text: tone, constraints, language. Never mention expected gaps.
promptHint: The system prompt assembled by the backend, without any secret. It never contains gaps or hints about gaps.
profilesHint: Provider and model settings. The endpoint is referenced by name; no URL or key is entered or shown here.
endpointRefHint: Name of the server configuration, not a URL.
accessDescription: Which agent may read which knowledge base. An agent can never retrieve text outside the bases ticked here.
matrixEmptyHint: Create at least one agent and one knowledge base.
allHaveKb: Every agent has at least one knowledge base
impactView: Who can read each knowledge base
deleteProfileMsg: Delete the profile “{{name}}”? This cannot be undone. A profile used by an agent cannot be deleted: change that agent's profile first.
